name: Fly smoke ProPR MCP
prompt: This is a ProPR MCP transport smoke test. Call the ProPR MCP tool list_repositories exactly once, with no arguments. Your report must start with one line: "PROPR_MCP_REPOSITORIES: " followed by the repository names the tool returned, comma-separated and in the order returned. Do not guess or take the names from anywhere else. If the tool call fails, start the report with "PROPR_MCP_ERROR: " and the error instead.
